input.overview: Pistol Poker builds five poker hands, converts each completed hand into a chip at the gun saucer, and turns those chips into the longer trip toward Pistol Mania. Megamode runs alongside that hand progression: advance every suit from 10 through Ace for four Jackpots, then shoot the Joker for its Super Jackpot.
input.simpleOverview: Hit the flashing cards needed for the current poker hand, then shoot a flashing Complete Hand shot. Shoot the gun saucer for the chip and a flipper-selected prize; after all five chips, shoot the Joker for Pistol Mania.
input.summary: Follow the flashing cards for the current hand, shoot a flashing Complete Hand shot, then collect the chip at the gun saucer. Choose Megamode when it is offered, advance all four suits through their Aces, and shoot the red-lit Joker after every suit is complete.

quickInfo.name: Poker hands
quickInfo.summary: The five hands arrive in order: one pair, two pair, three of a kind, full house, then royal flush. Only the flashing cards belong to the current hand.

quickInfo.name: Collecting a chip
quickInfo.summary: After completing the hand, shoot the gun saucer. Use the left or right flipper to choose one of the two displayed prizes.

quickInfo.name: Megamode
quickInfo.summary: Start it at a blue-lit Joker, by choosing it after a chip, or from Mystery. Each suit advances 10, Jack, Queen, King, then Ace.

quickInfo.name: Backbox gun
quickInfo.summary: Gun-saucer shots advance Ready, Aim, and Fire. Select a suit, then press a flipper button while the desired coin is lit to spot the card under it.

quickInfo.name: Pistol Mania
quickInfo.summary: Collect all five hand chips, then shoot the Joker. Additional balls are served and switches score until only one ball remains.

steps.text: Hit the flashing card targets needed for the current poker hand. When the hand is ready, shoot any playfield shot whose Complete Hand lamp is flashing.
Shoot the gun saucer to collect that hand's chip. Read the two displayed prizes and press the flipper for the one you want; take Megamode when it appears if you want the multiball route.
If Megamode is not already running, shoot the Joker when its blue lamp is lit. It can also begin from Mystery or the chip-prize choice.
During Megamode, hit the flashing card in each suit to advance from 10 through Ace. The upper loop can spot a Spade, while the lit Collect Card shots can spot their named suit.
Each collected Ace awards that suit's Jackpot. After all four suits are complete, shoot the Joker while its red lamp is lit for the Super Jackpot.
To grow two-ball Megamode into three-ball play, lock one ball at the Joker, then shoot the gun so the game locks the second and serves a third ball.
Complete and collect the chips for one pair, two pair, three of a kind, full house, and royal flush.
After the fifth chip is collected, shoot the Joker.
Keep the served balls alive and hit switches; Pistol Mania continues until only one ball remains.

playfieldReferences.label: Gun and chip saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The center saucer that collects a completed hand's chip and advances Ready-Aim-Fire.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper Joker lock hole
playfieldReferences.description: The upper lock hole used by Mystery, Megamode, its Super Jackpot, and Pistol Mania.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper loop
playfieldReferences.description: The loop across the upper playfield that can spot a Spade during Megamode.

cautions.issue: AG10/R3 leaves some individual mode timing and prize values incomplete.
cautions.response: Use the visible lamps and display for individual mode timing, prize values, and unfinished features.
